card.name: BV or MV ending abbreviations
card.fires_on: The letters BV or MV when they complete an abbreviation, mostly the BV in RBV (ribavirin) or HBV in hepatitis treatment regimens. Also in BVd (a drug combination) and the end of a brand name.
